objective: Frozen computation: the finite check behind the proof (every presentation with at most 11 distinctions, every first knot); exact KF3 order distributions for every presentation of lines of 5 to 8 to three new distinctions and of 5 to 7 to four; the three five-start placements and the six-starts to n = 10.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (refereed R1, confirmed with fixes, scoped to fewest-knot presentations; 6 of 8 predictions held): the finite check holds on every bracketing to n0 = 11; through n0 + 3 the distribution of the number of orders depends only on the bare bracketing (every presentation of 5 to 9) and separates them; the halves enter at n0 + 4 (all non-mirror pairs differ at 5-7; one tie at 8, 24 of 217 pairs at 9: Q4 failed at 8); next to an end equals the end through n = 8 and differs at 9; the six-starts differ at 10; Q8 failed: the branching follows not the pair-sharing tree but, post hoc, the meeting pattern itself.
title: Census of presentations: when the nesting's order enters
